speaker: Sheldon
text: The plural of coccyx is coccyges. Screw you, give me back my lima beans.

speaker: Bernadette
text: Oh my god, have you ever been so embarrassed? I don't know which was lemur, the roller skating or their disco dancing.

speaker: Penny
text: Not recently. For me, the worst part was when people saw a sleeve with them.

speaker: Leonard
text: You had some nice moves out there, Howard. Hey, did you notice all the people looking at us?

speaker: Bernadette
text: When Howard tried to do the split, I'm shh.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sorry, I'm moving a little slow. I think I bruised my coccyx.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, poor baby.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Thanks, you too. Don't tell Kuthrapali.

speaker: Leonard
text: After you.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, what a gentleman. Hey Sheldon.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh my god, are you... Good lord, you're ruining everything.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, damn. Do I look okay?

speaker: Leonard
text: You okay? Don't bark at me, I fell too.

speaker: Penny
text: No, you've been falling all night, you're used to it.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, what the hell are you doing?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Same thing I've been doing for three days, trying to figure out why electrons behave as if they have no mass when traveling through a graphene sheet.

speaker: Bernadette
text: With marbles?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I needed something bigger than peas, now didn't I?

speaker: Bernadette
text: Sheldon, when was the last time you got any sleep?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I don't know, two, three days, not important. I don't need sleep. I need answers. I need to determine where in this swamp of unbalanced formulas squatteth the toad of truth.

speaker: Penny
text: The toad of truth? Is that a physics thing?

speaker: Leonard
text: No, that's a crazy thing.

speaker: Bernadette
text: Okay, Sheldon, what happens to our neuroreceptors when we don't get enough REM sleep?

speaker: Sheldon
text: They lose their sensitivity to serotonin and norepinephrine. Impaired cognitive function.

speaker: Bernadette
text: Which leads to?

speaker: Bernadette
text: Right. So march in there, brush your teeth, and go to bed.

speaker: Sheldon
text: But I don't want to go to bed.

speaker: Bernadette
text: I'm gonna count to three. One.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, alright.

speaker: Leonard
text: That was amazing how you handled him.

speaker: Bernadette
text: I know how to deal with stubborn children. My mother used to run an illegal daycare center in our basement.
